name: 雇用保険料 (employment insurance)
authority: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) §4, §5 (every business employing a worker), §6 (not covered: under 20 contracted hours a week unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application; not expected to be employed 31 days or more; seasonal, students, certain crew and public servants), §37-5 (65-plus two-job special insured). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2) (賃金: every payment for labour, bonuses included), §2(4) (保険年度 1 April–31 March), §11 (premium = 賃金総額 × rate), §12(4) (雇用保険率), §31(1) (the insured worker bears 失業等給付・育児休業給付 at half the rate less the 二事業率), §32 (deducted from each wage payment). Rates per 1,000 (worker/employer): 令和7年度 general 5.5/9, agriculture-forestry-fisheries-sake 6.5/10, construction 6.5/11 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001401966.pdf); 令和8年度 (1 April 2026–31 March 2027) 5/8.5, 6/9.5, 6/10.5 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf). The rate is the fiscal year of the wage closing date (賃金締切日): a March close paid in April stays at the 令和7年度 rate — the run’s settings version is the one covering the salary window’s end. Worker share rounding when deducted from wages (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/www2/topics/seido/daijin/hoken/980916_3.htm): 50銭以下切り捨て、50銭を超える場合は切り上げ. Enrolment guidance: https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/0000147331.html. The employer share on a payslip is its rate on the same wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

elections.label: 被保険者の種類 (insured category)
elections.description: 雇用保険法 §6(i), §37-5: GENERAL for an ordinary insured worker (20 contracted hours a week or more, 31 days expected); MULTI_JOB_65 for a 65-plus worker insured on application through two employments (each 5 to under 20 hours, 20 combined), who pays on this employer’s own wages.

rules.refusal: 雇用保険法 §4–§7: record the 雇用保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person §6 excludes (under 20 contracted hours a week, not expected to be employed 31 days, a student, seasonal work).
労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4): the employment-insurance rate turns on the business class. Record the company’s employment_insurance_class (GENERAL, AGRICULTURE_SAKE or CONSTRUCTION).

雇用保険法 §6(i): a worker contracted for under 20 hours a week is not an insured person unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application. Record the registration NOT_REGISTERED, the insured_category MULTI_JOB_65, or correct the contracted week.

name: 労災保険料 (workers’ compensation insurance, employer only)
authority: 労働者災害補償保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000050) §3 (every business employing a worker). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2), §11 (賃金総額 × rate), §12(2) (労災保険率 by business type), §12(3) (メリット制), §31 (the worker bears none: employer only). Rate table: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行; https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/roudoukijun/rousai/rousaihoken06/rousai_hokenritsu_kaitei.html: 令和8年度 unchanged). The payslip figure is the employer’s cost at the business type’s rate on the payslip’s wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額 and discards the yen fraction).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

rules.refusal: 労働者災害補償保険法 §3; 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(2): record the company’s workers_comp_business_type, the 労災保険率表 事業の種類の番号 of its labour-insurance relationship.

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（給与） (income tax withholding on wages)
authority: 所得税法 §183, §185, §190 and 別表第五 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 東日本大震災からの復興のための施策を実施するために必要な財源の確保に関する特別措置法 §28: the payer withholds 所得税 and 復興特別所得税 together on the pay due, by the 平成24年財務省告示第115号 tables that fold the 2.1% surtax in (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm; table selection https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm). The table read is the pay after the 社会保険料 deducted from it (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金, 子ども・子育て支援金, 雇用保険 employee shares of this payslip; 雇用保険 on a payslip that also pays a 賞与 is split pro rata to the wages, a recorded default). The pay-due date (the run’s pay date, else the period end) picks the year: 令和7年分 for pay due in 2025, 令和8年分 in 2026; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables (防衛特別所得税) are sealed. 月額表 甲欄 (§185(1)(i)) where the 扶養控除等申告書 is filed (withholding_column KOU) by the declared 扶養親族等の数, beyond seven the seven-dependant amount less JPY1,610 each; 乙欄 (OTSU) otherwise; 毎半月 pay reads the table on twice the pay and withholds half (§185(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ). 日額表 丙欄 (HEI, §185(1)(iii)) on each day’s pay: the period’s pay after insurance over its paid days (working days less unpaid days), equal daily pay being the recorded default. Weekly pay (日割額, §185(1)(i)ヘ) is refused until the 施行令 日割額 is configured. The entity fact gensen_electronic_calculation elects the 電算機計算の特例 (平成24年財務省告示第116号; 令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf, 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf) for monthly 甲欄 pay: salary deduction (rounded up to the yen), basic deduction and JPY31,667 per 扶養親族等 off the pay after insurance, the tax formula rounded to JPY10. Table amounts above the band table (JPY740,000 a month) add the stated percentage of the excess; the sub-yen fraction is dropped (recorded default). 非居住者 (§212, §213; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2884.htm): 20.42% of the taxable pay before insurance, sub-yen dropped. Taxable pay (所得税法 §9(1)(v), (vi); 所得税基本通達 36-38の2, 36-40–36-45): the 通勤手当 class COMMUTING above the monthly limit (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm) — transit terms fact commute_transit_fare plus the vehicle band for commute_vehicle_km one way (under 2 km nil; 2–10 km 4,200; 10–15 7,300; 15–25 13,500; 25–35 19,700; 35–45 25,900; 45–55 32,300; 55–65 38,700; from pay due 1 April 2026 65–75 45,700, 75–85 52,700, 85–95 59,600, 95+ 66,400, before then 38,700 from 55 km, and from then commute_parking_fee up to 5,000 where the vehicle distance is 2 km or more), at most JPY150,000; the in-kind meal class MEAL_IN_KIND (the month’s meal value before consumption tax) is untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge, fraction under JPY10 dropped, is at most JPY3,500 a month (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026; https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm), else the value less the charge is pay; employer housing (terms facts housing_provided and the 賃貸料相当額 inputs, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): 固定資産税課税標準額 of the building × 0.2% + JPY12 × floor area ÷ 3.3 m² + land × 0.22%, taxable less the worker’s rent unless the worker pays at least 50% of it, sub-yen dropped. 年末調整 (§190, the December last payment of a KOU resident whose year’s pay is at most JPY20m): the year’s regular and 賞与 pay (this employer’s slips plus the prior-employer 源泉徴収票 recorded as the scheme opening) gives the 給与所得控除後の給与等の金額 — 令和7年分 別表第五 (JPY651,000–1.9m less 650,000; JPY1.9m–6.6m on the pay floored to JPY4,000: 70% less 80,000 to 3.6m, 80% less 440,000 above; e-Gov text as of 1 December 2025, every row checked) and 令和8年分 租税特別措置法 §29の4 with 別表第五 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1410.htm: under JPY741,000 nil, to 2.191m less 740,000, 1,451,000 / 1,453,000 / 1,456,000 to 2.2m, then 別表第五), 90% less 1.1m from 6.6m, less 1.95m from 8.5m — less 所得金額調整控除 (yearend_income_adjustment, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1411.htm); less 社会保険料 (this employer’s shares plus SOCIAL_INSURANCE and SMALL_ENTERPRISE_MUTUAL_AID claims), LIFE_INSURANCE (≤120,000, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1140.htm), EARTHQUAKE_INSURANCE (≤50,000, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1145.htm), SPOUSE and SPECIFIED_RELATIVE claims as the 配偶者控除等申告書 and 特定親族特別控除申告書 state them, 扶養控除 (38万 general, 63万 特定, 48万 老人, 58万 同居老親等; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm), 障害者 27万 / 特別 40万 / 同居特別 75万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1160.htm), 寡婦 27万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1170.htm), ひとり親 35万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1171.htm), 勤労学生 27万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1175.htm) and the 基礎控除 on the 基礎控除申告書 (yearend_basic_declaration; 合計所得 = salary income plus yearend_other_income; 令和7年分 95万/88万/68万/63万/58万 to 1.32m/3.36m/4.89m/6.55m/23.5m, 令和8年分 104万 to 4.89m, 67万 to 6.55m, 62万 to 23.5m, then 48万/32万/16万/0 to 25m; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1199.htm, https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026kiso/index.htm); the taxable amount floored to JPY1,000, the §89 rates (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2260.htm), less the HOUSING_LOAN_CREDIT claim, × 102.1%, floored to JPY100, less the year’s withholding (this scheme and INCOME_TAX_BONUS, prior employer included); a negative charge is the refund.

elections.label: 基礎控除申告書 filed
elections.description: 所得税法 §190(2)(ヘ), §195の3 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1199.htm): true where the worker filed the 給与所得者の基礎控除申告書 for the year; false where not (no 基礎控除 in the 年末調整). Required for the December settlement.

elections.label: 合計所得金額 other than this salary (見積額)
elections.description: The 基礎控除申告書 estimate of the year’s 合計所得金額 other than the salary this payer settles; the 基礎控除 band reads the total.

elections.label: 一般の控除対象扶養親族
elections.description: 所得税法 §84 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm): JPY380,000 each.

elections.label: 特定扶養親族 (19–22 on 31 December)
elections.description: 所得税法 §84 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm): JPY630,000 each.

elections.label: 老人扶養親族 (70+, not 同居老親等)
elections.description: 所得税法 §84 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm): JPY480,000 each.

elections.description: 租税特別措置法 §41の16 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm): JPY580,000 each.

elections.label: 寡婦

elections.label: ひとり親
elections.description: 所得税法 §81 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1171.htm): JPY350,000.

elections.label: 所得金額調整控除申告書 filed (eligible)

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（賞与） (income tax withholding on a bonus)
authority: 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 平成24年財務省告示第115号 別表第三 賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表 (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm): the 賞与 after its 社会保険料 (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金 and 子ども・子育て支援金 on the 標準賞与額, and the 雇用保険 share of the payslip pro rata to the bonus) × the rate read by the previous month’s ordinary pay after insurance and the 扶養親族等の数 (甲欄, seven and more in one column) or the 乙欄 (乙 and 丙), sub-yen dropped; where there was no ordinary pay in the previous month, or the bonus exceeds ten times it, §186(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ and §186(2): (the 月額表 amount on one sixth of the bonus plus that previous-month pay, less the amount on that pay) × 6. The previous month’s pay after insurance is the declared election prior_month_net_pay (0 for none): the scheme site cannot read an earlier payslip, so the payroll is refused without it. A bonus whose computation period exceeds six months (1/12, × 12) is not configured. 非居住者: 20.42%. The pay-due date picks the year as for INCOME_TAX; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables are sealed.

elections.label: 前月の社会保険料等控除後の給与等の金額
elections.description: 所得税法 §186(1)–(2): the ordinary pay due in the month before the bonus after its 社会保険料, 0 where none was due; a pay cycle of a whole number of months reads the monthly equivalent of the last ordinary pay. Record on the bonus month’s declaration.

rules.refusal: "所得税法 §2(1)(iii)–(v): record tax residency (RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT) on the employment terms before withholding: a resident is withheld by the 源泉徴収税額表, a non-resident at 20.42% (§212, §213); citizenship does not decide it."

"源泉徴収税額表: the pay due date falls outside the sealed 令和7年分・令和8年分 tables; pay due from 1 January 2027 needs the 令和9年分 tables (令和9年 防衛特別所得税, https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2027/01.htm), not yet sealed."

"所得税法 §186: the 賞与 rate is read on the previous month’s ordinary pay after 社会保険料. Record it as prior_month_net_pay on the INCOME_TAX_BONUS statutory fact for the bonus month (0 where no ordinary pay was due in the previous month) before withholding the bonus."

name: 個人住民税（特別徴収） (resident tax, special collection)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §321-3 (the municipality designates the salary payer as 特別徴収義務者), §321-4 (notice of the 特別徴収税額 by 31 May), §321-5(1) (one twelfth each month from June to the following May, withheld when pay is paid, remitted by the next month’s tenth; a notice received later is spread over the months from the month after it to May), §321-5(2) (a worker who stops receiving pay: no later installment is withheld, except that the remaining installments are withheld in one amount from the pay or retirement allowance paid by 31 May exceeding them — on the worker’s request for an event from 1 June to 31 December, always for an event from 1 January to 30 April), §20-4-2(6), (8) (the installment fractions under JPY100 fall to the first installment, so June differs); 森林環境税 is collected with it (森林環境税及び森林環境譲与税に関する法律 §7). The amounts are the municipality’s, never a national formula: the terms facts resident_tax_collection SPECIAL, resident_tax_fiscal_year, resident_tax_june_amount (the first installment), resident_tax_monthly_amount and resident_tax_first_month transcribe the 特別徴収税額の決定・変更通知書 (Shinjuku https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html). The pay date (else the period end) picks the installment month. Recorded defaults (owner rule 2026-09-28): one installment a month, on the month’s first payment; nothing withheld from a payslip that pays nothing; the exit collection is on the payslip of the pay period containing the last day, comparing its whole pay (wages, bonus and retirement allowance) with the remaining installments; unrecorded resident_tax_exit_collection is no request (June–December) and LUMP_SUM (January–April, as the statute requires); TRANSFER (the new employer continues the collection) and ORDINARY withhold the exit month’s installment only.
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（退職所得） (income tax withholding on a retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033) §30 (退職所得: the year’s 退職手当等 less the 退職所得控除額, halved; 短期退職手当等 — non-officer service of five years or less — halves only the first JPY3m of the excess and takes the rest whole, i.e. 1.5m + (payment − (3m + deduction)); 特定役員退職手当等 — 役員等 service of five years or less — is the whole excess; 退職所得控除額 JPY400,000 a year to 20 years, then 8m + 700,000 a year; less the §30(6)(i) amount for an earlier retirement allowance; at least 800,000; +1m for a retirement caused by disability), §89 (rates 5–45%), §201(1) (with the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書: tax on the 課税退職所得金額, its sub-JPY1,000 fraction dropped; an already-paid allowance of the same year and kind is combined and its tax deducted), §201(3) (without the declaration: 20% of the whole payment), §212–§213 (a non-resident: 20%). 施行令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096) §69 (service years: a part year counts as one), §70 (the overlap reduction: the deduction for the years a prior allowance covered — received within the previous four years, or from 2026 a DC lump sum within nine years and allowances then nine years back for one received from 2026 — fraction of a year dropped, §70(2) shortening them where the prior allowance fell short of its own deduction), §71 (disability). 復興特別所得税 2.1% (復興財源確保法 §28) so the tax is ×102.1%, 20.42% without a declaration; the sub-yen fraction dropped (NTA No.2732, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm, 令和8年4月1日現在). Inputs are exit facts: retirement_income_declaration, retirement_service_years (the §69 years; unrecorded is the stint through the last day, a part year one year), retirement_officer_service_years, retirement_disability, retirement_deduction_reduction_years (the §70 years the declaration shows), retirement_prior_same_year_amount/_income_tax/_kind. The class RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE is its only base. Mixed officer and employee service with a five-year part (施行令 §71-2) is refused.

name: 住民税 退職所得割（特別徴収） (resident tax on a retirement allowance)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §50-2–§50-6 (道府県民税 4%) and §328–§328-6 (市町村民税 6%): the 退職所得割 on a 退職手当等 subject to 所得税法 §199 (a resident’s) is taxed apart from other income by the municipality and prefecture of the worker’s address on 1 January of the year it is payable, on the 退職所得の金額 computed as 所得税法 §30(2) (§328-2), special-collected by the payer at payment and remitted with a 納入申告書 by the next month’s tenth (§328-5); the declaration only adds an already-paid allowance of the year (§328-6(1)); without one the tax is the same computation on this payment (§328-6(2)). §20-4-2(1): the taxable amount drops its sub-JPY1,000 fraction; §20-4-2(3): each tax drops its sub-JPY100 fraction (municipal and prefectural computed apart). No 復興 surtax, no 森林環境税. Shinjuku retirement-tax procedure: https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_00005.html. Exit fact resident_tax_january_domicile false where the worker had no address in Japan on that 1 January; retirement_prior_same_year_resident_tax is the already-withheld amount.

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料 (health and care insurance)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §40 (50 grades of 標準報酬月額, JPY58,000–1,390,000), §156 (premium on the 標準報酬月額 for each month from acquisition to the month before loss), §160 (協会けんぽ branch rates), §161 (half each), §167(1) (the employer deducts only the previous month’s premium from pay; at loss the previous and the current month); 介護保険法 §9(2) (insured aged 40–64 pay the care rate with health). Rates: 協会けんぽ 保険料額表 — 令和8年度 rates for the collected month (care 1.62%), 令和8年度 for the current month (care 1.62%) (https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/about/business/insurance_rate/rate_prefectures/r08/; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r7ippan3.xlsx). The branch is the prefecture of the company (the 適用事業所), never the worker’s residence. Care applies from the month containing the day before the 40th birthday to the month before the one containing the day before the 65th; health ends on the 75th birthday (後期高齢者医療). Employee share rounding (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042; JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/nofu/20121026.html): deducted from pay, 50 sen and under is discarded and over 50 sen is one yen; the employer share is the month’s premium less that deduction. Maternity/childcare exemption (§159, §159-3): on the employer’s application no premium is collected for the exempt months (election premium_exemption).

elections.label: 標準報酬月額 (the grade of the month this payslip collects)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §40–43: the grade decided at acquisition (資格取得時決定), each September (定時決定, from April–June pay) and on a qualifying fixed-pay change (随時改定, from the fourth month). Payroll deducts the previous month’s premium (§167(1)), so date a revised grade from the first day of the month after the insurance month it takes effect (a September 定時決定 grade from 1 October); date the acquisition grade from the acquisition day. The pension grade is this grade bounded to the 厚生年金 table (厚生年金保険法 §20).

elections.label: 産前産後・育児休業等の保険料免除 (exempt collected month)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §159, §159-3; 厚生年金保険法 §81-2, §81-2-2: on the employer’s 申出, no health, care, pension or support premium is collected for the months from the month the leave starts to the month before the one containing the day after it ends (childcare leave inside one month: 14 days or more). Record MATERNITY or CHILDCARE for the exempt insurance months as the pension office accepted them, dated like the grade (from the month after the first exempt month to the month after the last). NONE is no exemption.

rules.refusal: 健康保険法 §35, §48: record the 健康保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since and the 標準報酬月額), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person outside compulsory cover.
健康保険法 §3, 介護保険法 §9(2), 厚生年金保険法 §9: care (40–64), pension (under 70) and health (under 75) cover turn on age. Record the date of birth before calculating payroll.
健康保険法 §156(3), 厚生年金保険法 §19(1): premiums run from the month of acquisition. Record the 資格取得日 as the registration since date.

authority: 厚生年金保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115) §20 (32 grades JPY88,000–650,000 for the current month; JPY650,000 top for the collected month), §81(4) (18.3% of the 標準報酬月額), §82 (half each), §84 (previous month deducted from pay; at loss the previous and the current month), §9 and §14 (cover ends at 70: loss on the day before the 70th birthday, the month of loss unpaid). Top-grade phase-up to JPY680,000 (September 2027), 710,000 (September 2028) and 750,000 (September 2029) insurance months under the 2025 pension reform Act (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/0000147284_00024.html). Employee share rounded as HEALTH (50 sen down, over up; https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/nofu/20121026.html).

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料（賞与） (health and care insurance on a bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §3(6) (a payment for labour made three or fewer times a year), §45(1) (標準賞与額: the bonus with sub-JPY1,000 discarded, at most JPY5,730,000 in the April–March year under one insurer), §156(1)(ii), §160, §161, §167(2) (deducted from the bonus); the bonus month’s own rates (令和8年度, care 1.62%, https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx); a bonus paid in the month of loss carries no premium but still counts toward the cap (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/hoshu/20141203.html). The cap is exact where the April–March total is recorded (standard_bonus_fiscal_year_prior); unrecorded, a bonus is priced only where this employer’s earlier standard bonuses since 1 January (and last year’s, for a January–March bonus) cannot reach the cap, and refused otherwise. Rounding as HEALTH.

Date it over the bonus month.

authority: こども家庭庁 (https://www.cfa.go.jp/policies/kodomokosodateshienkinseido); 協会けんぽ 令和8年度 notes (https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx): 0.23% of the 標準賞与額 from the April 2026 insurance month, sharing the health JPY5,730,000 April–March cap (the HEALTH_BONUS base), half each, deducted from the bonus, with the health bonus’s loss-month, age-75 and exemption tests. Rounding as HEALTH.

name: 子ども・子育て拠出金 (employer child and childcare contribution)
short_name: 子ども・子育て拠出金
authority: 子ども・子育て支援法 §69–§71 (employer-only 拠出金 on each 厚生年金 insured person’s 標準報酬月額 and 標準賞与額), rate 0.36% from the April 2020 insurance month and unchanged for 令和8年度 (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/ryogaku/ryogakuhyo/20200825.html; 協会けんぽ table notes https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx); collected with the pension premium, previous month, on the pension grade and the pension standard bonus (JPY1.5m monthly cap). Recorded default: none for a premium-exempt month, following the pension premium it is collected with.

name: 雇用保険料 (employment insurance)
authority: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) §4, §5 (every business employing a worker), §6 (not covered: under 20 contracted hours a week unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application; not expected to be employed 31 days or more; seasonal, students, certain crew and public servants), §37-5 (65-plus two-job special insured). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2) (賃金: every payment for labour, bonuses included), §2(4) (保険年度 1 April–31 March), §11 (premium = 賃金総額 × rate), §12(4) (雇用保険率), §31(1) (the insured worker bears 失業等給付・育児休業給付 at half the rate less the 二事業率), §32 (deducted from each wage payment). Rates per 1,000 (worker/employer): 令和7年度 general 5.5/9, agriculture-forestry-fisheries-sake 6.5/10, construction 6.5/11 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001401966.pdf); 令和8年度 (1 April 2026–31 March 2027) 5/8.5, 6/9.5, 6/10.5 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf). The rate is the fiscal year of the wage closing date (賃金締切日): a March close paid in April stays at the 令和7年度 rate — the run’s settings version is the one covering the salary window’s end. Worker share rounding when deducted from wages (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/www2/topics/seido/daijin/hoken/980916_3.htm): 50銭以下切り捨て、50銭を超える場合は切り上げ. Enrolment guidance: https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/0000147331.html. The employer share on a payslip is its rate on the same wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

elections.label: 被保険者の種類 (insured category)
elections.description: 雇用保険法 §6(i), §37-5: GENERAL for an ordinary insured worker (20 contracted hours a week or more, 31 days expected); MULTI_JOB_65 for a 65-plus worker insured on application through two employments (each 5 to under 20 hours, 20 combined), who pays on this employer’s own wages.

rules.refusal: 雇用保険法 §4–§7: record the 雇用保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person §6 excludes (under 20 contracted hours a week, not expected to be employed 31 days, a student, seasonal work).
労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4): the employment-insurance rate turns on the business class. Record the company’s employment_insurance_class (GENERAL, AGRICULTURE_SAKE or CONSTRUCTION).

雇用保険法 §6(i): a worker contracted for under 20 hours a week is not an insured person unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application. Record the registration NOT_REGISTERED, the insured_category MULTI_JOB_65, or correct the contracted week.

name: 労災保険料 (workers’ compensation insurance, employer only)
authority: 労働者災害補償保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000050) §3 (every business employing a worker). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2), §11 (賃金総額 × rate), §12(2) (労災保険率 by business type), §12(3) (メリット制), §31 (the worker bears none: employer only). Rate table: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行; https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/roudoukijun/rousai/rousaihoken06/rousai_hokenritsu_kaitei.html: 令和8年度 unchanged). The payslip figure is the employer’s cost at the business type’s rate on the payslip’s wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額 and discards the yen fraction).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

rules.refusal: 労働者災害補償保険法 §3; 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(2): record the company’s workers_comp_business_type, the 労災保険率表 事業の種類の番号 of its labour-insurance relationship.

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（給与） (income tax withholding on wages)
authority: 所得税法 §183, §185, §190 and 別表第五 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 東日本大震災からの復興のための施策を実施するために必要な財源の確保に関する特別措置法 §28: the payer withholds 所得税 and 復興特別所得税 together on the pay due, by the 平成24年財務省告示第115号 tables that fold the 2.1% surtax in (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm; table selection https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm). The table read is the pay after the 社会保険料 deducted from it (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金, 子ども・子育て支援金, 雇用保険 employee shares of this payslip; 雇用保険 on a payslip that also pays a 賞与 is split pro rata to the wages, a recorded default). The pay-due date (the run’s pay date, else the period end) picks the year: 令和7年分 for pay due in 2025, 令和8年分 in 2026; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables (防衛特別所得税) are sealed. 月額表 甲欄 (§185(1)(i)) where the 扶養控除等申告書 is filed (withholding_column KOU) by the declared 扶養親族等の数, beyond seven the seven-dependant amount less JPY1,610 each; 乙欄 (OTSU) otherwise; 毎半月 pay reads the table on twice the pay and withholds half (§185(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ). 日額表 丙欄 (HEI, §185(1)(iii)) on each day’s pay: the period’s pay after insurance over its paid days (working days less unpaid days), equal daily pay being the recorded default. Weekly pay (日割額, §185(1)(i)ヘ) is refused until the 施行令 日割額 is configured. The entity fact gensen_electronic_calculation elects the 電算機計算の特例 (平成24年財務省告示第116号; 令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf, 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf) for monthly 甲欄 pay: salary deduction (rounded up to the yen), basic deduction and JPY31,667 per 扶養親族等 off the pay after insurance, the tax formula rounded to JPY10. Table amounts above the band table (JPY740,000 a month) add the stated percentage of the excess; the sub-yen fraction is dropped (recorded default). 非居住者 (§212, §213; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2884.htm): 20.42% of the taxable pay before insurance, sub-yen dropped. Taxable pay (所得税法 §9(1)(v), (vi); 所得税基本通達 36-38の2, 36-40–36-45): the 通勤手当 class COMMUTING above the monthly limit (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm) — transit terms fact commute_transit_fare plus the vehicle band for commute_vehicle_km one way (under 2 km nil; 2–10 km 4,200; 10–15 7,300; 15–25 13,500; 25–35 19,700; 35–45 25,900; 45–55 32,300; 55–65 38,700; from pay due 1 April 2026 65–75 45,700, 75–85 52,700, 85–95 59,600, 95+ 66,400, before then 38,700 from 55 km, and from then commute_parking_fee up to 5,000 where the vehicle distance is 2 km or more), at most JPY150,000; the in-kind meal class MEAL_IN_KIND (the month’s meal value before consumption tax) is untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge, fraction under JPY10 dropped, is at most JPY3,500 a month (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026; https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm), else the value less the charge is pay; employer housing (terms facts housing_provided and the 賃貸料相当額 inputs, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): 固定資産税課税標準額 of the building × 0.2% + JPY12 × floor area ÷ 3.3 m² + land × 0.22%, taxable less the worker’s rent unless the worker pays at least 50% of it, sub-yen dropped. 年末調整 (§190, the December last payment of a KOU resident whose year’s pay is at most JPY20m): the year’s regular and 賞与 pay (this employer’s slips plus the prior-employer 源泉徴収票 recorded as the scheme opening) gives the 給与所得控除後の給与等の金額 — 令和7年分 別表第五 (JPY651,000–1.9m less 650,000; JPY1.9m–6.6m on the pay floored to JPY4,000: 70% less 80,000 to 3.6m, 80% less 440,000 above; e-Gov text as of 1 December 2025, every row checked) and 令和8年分 租税特別措置法 §29の4 with 別表第五 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1410.htm: under JPY741,000 nil, to 2.191m less 740,000, 1,451,000 / 1,453,000 / 1,456,000 to 2.2m, then 別表第五), 90% less 1.1m from 6.6m, less 1.95m from 8.5m — less 所得金額調整控除 (yearend_income_adjustment, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1411.htm); less 社会保険料 (this employer’s shares plus SOCIAL_INSURANCE and SMALL_ENTERPRISE_MUTUAL_AID claims), LIFE_INSURANCE (≤120,000, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1140.htm), EARTHQUAKE_INSURANCE (≤50,000, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1145.htm), SPOUSE and SPECIFIED_RELATIVE claims as the 配偶者控除等申告書 and 特定親族特別控除申告書 state them, 扶養控除 (38万 general, 63万 特定, 48万 老人, 58万 同居老親等; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1180.htm), 障害者 27万 / 特別 40万 / 同居特別 75万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1160.htm), 寡婦 27万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1170.htm), ひとり親 35万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1171.htm), 勤労学生 27万 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1175.htm) and the 基礎控除 on the 基礎控除申告書 (yearend_basic_declaration; 合計所得 = salary income plus yearend_other_income; 令和7年分 95万/88万/68万/63万/58万 to 1.32m/3.36m/4.89m/6.55m/23.5m, 令和8年分 104万 to 4.89m, 67万 to 6.55m, 62万 to 23.5m, then 48万/32万/16万/0 to 25m; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1199.htm, https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026kiso/index.htm); the taxable amount floored to JPY1,000, the §89 rates (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2260.htm), less the HOUSING_LOAN_CREDIT claim, × 102.1%, floored to JPY100, less the year’s withholding (this scheme and INCOME_TAX_BONUS, prior employer included); a negative charge is the refund.

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（賞与） (income tax withholding on a bonus)
authority: 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 平成24年財務省告示第115号 別表第三 賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表 (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm): the 賞与 after its 社会保険料 (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金 and 子ども・子育て支援金 on the 標準賞与額, and the 雇用保険 share of the payslip pro rata to the bonus) × the rate read by the previous month’s ordinary pay after insurance and the 扶養親族等の数 (甲欄, seven and more in one column) or the 乙欄 (乙 and 丙), sub-yen dropped; where there was no ordinary pay in the previous month, or the bonus exceeds ten times it, §186(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ and §186(2): (the 月額表 amount on one sixth of the bonus plus that previous-month pay, less the amount on that pay) × 6. The previous month’s pay after insurance is the declared election prior_month_net_pay (0 for none): the scheme site cannot read an earlier payslip, so the payroll is refused without it. A bonus whose computation period exceeds six months (1/12, × 12) is not configured. 非居住者: 20.42%. The pay-due date picks the year as for INCOME_TAX; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables are sealed.

elections.label: 前月の社会保険料等控除後の給与等の金額
elections.description: 所得税法 §186(1)–(2): the ordinary pay due in the month before the bonus after its 社会保険料, 0 where none was due; a pay cycle of a whole number of months reads the monthly equivalent of the last ordinary pay. Record on the bonus month’s declaration.

rules.refusal: "所得税法 §2(1)(iii)–(v): record tax residency (RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT) on the employment terms before withholding: a resident is withheld by the 源泉徴収税額表, a non-resident at 20.42% (§212, §213); citizenship does not decide it."

"源泉徴収税額表: the pay due date falls outside the sealed 令和7年分・令和8年分 tables; pay due from 1 January 2027 needs the 令和9年分 tables (令和9年 防衛特別所得税, https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2027/01.htm), not yet sealed."

"所得税法 §186: the 賞与 rate is read on the previous month’s ordinary pay after 社会保険料. Record it as prior_month_net_pay on the INCOME_TAX_BONUS statutory fact for the bonus month (0 where no ordinary pay was due in the previous month) before withholding the bonus."

name: 個人住民税（特別徴収） (resident tax, special collection)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §321-3 (the municipality designates the salary payer as 特別徴収義務者), §321-4 (notice of the 特別徴収税額 by 31 May), §321-5(1) (one twelfth each month from June to the following May, withheld when pay is paid, remitted by the next month’s tenth; a notice received later is spread over the months from the month after it to May), §321-5(2) (a worker who stops receiving pay: no later installment is withheld, except that the remaining installments are withheld in one amount from the pay or retirement allowance paid by 31 May exceeding them — on the worker’s request for an event from 1 June to 31 December, always for an event from 1 January to 30 April), §20-4-2(6), (8) (the installment fractions under JPY100 fall to the first installment, so June differs); 森林環境税 is collected with it (森林環境税及び森林環境譲与税に関する法律 §7). The amounts are the municipality’s, never a national formula: the terms facts resident_tax_collection SPECIAL, resident_tax_fiscal_year, resident_tax_june_amount (the first installment), resident_tax_monthly_amount and resident_tax_first_month transcribe the 特別徴収税額の決定・変更通知書 (Shinjuku https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html). The pay date (else the period end) picks the installment month. Recorded defaults (owner rule 2026-09-28): one installment a month, on the month’s first payment; nothing withheld from a payslip that pays nothing; the exit collection is on the payslip of the pay period containing the last day, comparing its whole pay (wages, bonus and retirement allowance) with the remaining installments; unrecorded resident_tax_exit_collection is no request (June–December) and LUMP_SUM (January–April, as the statute requires); TRANSFER (the new employer continues the collection) and ORDINARY withhold the exit month’s installment only.
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（退職所得） (income tax withholding on a retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033) §30 (退職所得: the year’s 退職手当等 less the 退職所得控除額, halved; 短期退職手当等 — non-officer service of five years or less — halves only the first JPY3m of the excess and takes the rest whole, i.e. 1.5m + (payment − (3m + deduction)); 特定役員退職手当等 — 役員等 service of five years or less — is the whole excess; 退職所得控除額 JPY400,000 a year to 20 years, then 8m + 700,000 a year; less the §30(6)(i) amount for an earlier retirement allowance; at least 800,000; +1m for a retirement caused by disability), §89 (rates 5–45%), §201(1) (with the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書: tax on the 課税退職所得金額, its sub-JPY1,000 fraction dropped; an already-paid allowance of the same year and kind is combined and its tax deducted), §201(3) (without the declaration: 20% of the whole payment), §212–§213 (a non-resident: 20%). 施行令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096) §69 (service years: a part year counts as one), §70 (the overlap reduction: the deduction for the years a prior allowance covered — received within the previous four years, or from 2026 a DC lump sum within nine years and allowances then nine years back for one received from 2026 — fraction of a year dropped, §70(2) shortening them where the prior allowance fell short of its own deduction), §71 (disability). 復興特別所得税 2.1% (復興財源確保法 §28) so the tax is ×102.1%, 20.42% without a declaration; the sub-yen fraction dropped (NTA No.2732, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm, 令和8年4月1日現在). Inputs are exit facts: retirement_income_declaration, retirement_service_years (the §69 years; unrecorded is the stint through the last day, a part year one year), retirement_officer_service_years, retirement_disability, retirement_deduction_reduction_years (the §70 years the declaration shows), retirement_prior_same_year_amount/_income_tax/_kind. The class RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE is its only base. Mixed officer and employee service with a five-year part (施行令 §71-2) is refused.

name: 住民税 退職所得割（特別徴収） (resident tax on a retirement allowance)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §50-2–§50-6 (道府県民税 4%) and §328–§328-6 (市町村民税 6%): the 退職所得割 on a 退職手当等 subject to 所得税法 §199 (a resident’s) is taxed apart from other income by the municipality and prefecture of the worker’s address on 1 January of the year it is payable, on the 退職所得の金額 computed as 所得税法 §30(2) (§328-2), special-collected by the payer at payment and remitted with a 納入申告書 by the next month’s tenth (§328-5); the declaration only adds an already-paid allowance of the year (§328-6(1)); without one the tax is the same computation on this payment (§328-6(2)). §20-4-2(1): the taxable amount drops its sub-JPY1,000 fraction; §20-4-2(3): each tax drops its sub-JPY100 fraction (municipal and prefectural computed apart). No 復興 surtax, no 森林環境税. Shinjuku retirement-tax procedure: https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_00005.html. Exit fact resident_tax_january_domicile false where the worker had no address in Japan on that 1 January; retirement_prior_same_year_resident_tax is the already-withheld amount.

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料 (health and care insurance)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §40 (50 grades of 標準報酬月額, JPY58,000–1,390,000), §156 (premium on the 標準報酬月額 for each month from acquisition to the month before loss), §160 (協会けんぽ branch rates), §161 (half each), §167(1) (the employer deducts only the previous month’s premium from pay; at loss the previous and the current month); 介護保険法 §9(2) (insured aged 40–64 pay the care rate with health). Rates: 協会けんぽ 保険料額表 — 令和8年度 rates for the collected month (care 1.62%), 令和8年度 for the current month (care 1.62%) (https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/about/business/insurance_rate/rate_prefectures/r08/; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r7ippan3.xlsx). The branch is the prefecture of the company (the 適用事業所), never the worker’s residence. Care applies from the month containing the day before the 40th birthday to the month before the one containing the day before the 65th; health ends on the 75th birthday (後期高齢者医療). Employee share rounding (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042; JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/nofu/20121026.html): deducted from pay, 50 sen and under is discarded and over 50 sen is one yen; the employer share is the month’s premium less that deduction. Maternity/childcare exemption (§159, §159-3): on the employer’s application no premium is collected for the exempt months (election premium_exemption).

elections.label: 標準報酬月額 (the grade of the month this payslip collects)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §40–43: the grade decided at acquisition (資格取得時決定), each September (定時決定, from April–June pay) and on a qualifying fixed-pay change (随時改定, from the fourth month). Payroll deducts the previous month’s premium (§167(1)), so date a revised grade from the first day of the month after the insurance month it takes effect (a September 定時決定 grade from 1 October); date the acquisition grade from the acquisition day. The pension grade is this grade bounded to the 厚生年金 table (厚生年金保険法 §20).

elections.label: 産前産後・育児休業等の保険料免除 (exempt collected month)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §159, §159-3; 厚生年金保険法 §81-2, §81-2-2: on the employer’s 申出, no health, care, pension or support premium is collected for the months from the month the leave starts to the month before the one containing the day after it ends (childcare leave inside one month: 14 days or more). Record MATERNITY or CHILDCARE for the exempt insurance months as the pension office accepted them, dated like the grade (from the month after the first exempt month to the month after the last). NONE is no exemption.

rules.refusal: 健康保険法 §35, §48: record the 健康保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since and the 標準報酬月額), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person outside compulsory cover.
健康保険法 §3, 介護保険法 §9(2), 厚生年金保険法 §9: care (40–64), pension (under 70) and health (under 75) cover turn on age. Record the date of birth before calculating payroll.
健康保険法 §156(3), 厚生年金保険法 §19(1): premiums run from the month of acquisition. Record the 資格取得日 as the registration since date.

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料（賞与） (health and care insurance on a bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §3(6) (a payment for labour made three or fewer times a year), §45(1) (標準賞与額: the bonus with sub-JPY1,000 discarded, at most JPY5,730,000 in the April–March year under one insurer), §156(1)(ii), §160, §161, §167(2) (deducted from the bonus); the bonus month’s own rates (令和8年度, care 1.62%, https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx); a bonus paid in the month of loss carries no premium but still counts toward the cap (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/hoshu/20141203.html). The cap is exact where the April–March total is recorded (standard_bonus_fiscal_year_prior); unrecorded, a bonus is priced only where this employer’s earlier standard bonuses since 1 January (and last year’s, for a January–March bonus) cannot reach the cap, and refused otherwise. Rounding as HEALTH.

elections.label: 年度内の標準賞与額累計 (before this bonus)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §45(1): the 標準賞与額 already counted under this insurer since the last 1 April — this employer’s earlier bonuses, and a same-insurer earlier employer’s where the worker filed the 累計額 declaration. Recorded, the JPY5,730,000 cap is applied exactly.

elections.label: 賞与保険料免除 (maternity / childcare leave)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §159, §159-3; 厚生年金保険法 §81-2, §81-2-2: a bonus paid in an exempt month (childcare leave: leave of more than one month spanning the bonus month’s end) carries no health, care, pension or support premium on the employer’s 申出; the bonus still counts toward the cap. Date it over the bonus month.

rules.when: base > 0.0 && !("standard_bonus_fiscal_year_prior" in scheme.election_keys) && scheme.year_to_date.base + (period.month <= 3 ? scheme.last_year.base : 0.0) + base > 5730000.0
rules.refusal: 健康保険法 §45(1): the 標準賞与額 is capped at JPY5,730,000 over each April–March under one insurer. This bonus may reach the cap: record standard_bonus_fiscal_year_prior (the standard bonus already counted since 1 April, including a same-insurer 累計額 declaration) on the HEALTH_BONUS registration.
健康保険法 §3, 介護保険法 §9(2), 厚生年金保険法 §9: care (40–64), pension (under 70) and health (under 75) cover turn on age. Record the date of birth before calculating payroll.
健康保険法 §7-2, §160: the 協会けんぽ rate is the branch rate of the prefecture where the 適用事業所 is. Set the company region to one of the 47 prefectures.

name: 雇用保険料 (employment insurance)
authority: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) §4, §5 (every business employing a worker), §6 (not covered: under 20 contracted hours a week unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application; not expected to be employed 31 days or more; seasonal, students, certain crew and public servants), §37-5 (65-plus two-job special insured). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2) (賃金: every payment for labour, bonuses included), §2(4) (保険年度 1 April–31 March), §11 (premium = 賃金総額 × rate), §12(4) (雇用保険率), §31(1) (the insured worker bears 失業等給付・育児休業給付 at half the rate less the 二事業率), §32 (deducted from each wage payment). Rates per 1,000 (worker/employer): 令和7年度 general 5.5/9, agriculture-forestry-fisheries-sake 6.5/10, construction 6.5/11 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001401966.pdf); 令和8年度 (1 April 2026–31 March 2027) 5/8.5, 6/9.5, 6/10.5 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf). The rate is the fiscal year of the wage closing date (賃金締切日): a March close paid in April stays at the 令和7年度 rate — the run’s settings version is the one covering the salary window’s end. Worker share rounding when deducted from wages (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/www2/topics/seido/daijin/hoken/980916_3.htm): 50銭以下切り捨て、50銭を超える場合は切り上げ. Enrolment guidance: https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/0000147331.html. The employer share on a payslip is its rate on the same wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

elections.label: 被保険者の種類 (insured category)
elections.description: 雇用保険法 §6(i), §37-5: GENERAL for an ordinary insured worker (20 contracted hours a week or more, 31 days expected); MULTI_JOB_65 for a 65-plus worker insured on application through two employments (each 5 to under 20 hours, 20 combined), who pays on this employer’s own wages.

rules.refusal: 雇用保険法 §4–§7: record the 雇用保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person §6 excludes (under 20 contracted hours a week, not expected to be employed 31 days, a student, seasonal work).
労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4): the employment-insurance rate turns on the business class. Record the company’s employment_insurance_class (GENERAL, AGRICULTURE_SAKE or CONSTRUCTION).

雇用保険法 §6(i): a worker contracted for under 20 hours a week is not an insured person unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application. Record the registration NOT_REGISTERED, the insured_category MULTI_JOB_65, or correct the contracted week.

name: 労災保険料 (workers’ compensation insurance, employer only)
authority: 労働者災害補償保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000050) §3 (every business employing a worker). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2), §11 (賃金総額 × rate), §12(2) (労災保険率 by business type), §12(3) (メリット制), §31 (the worker bears none: employer only). Rate table: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行; https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/roudoukijun/rousai/rousaihoken06/rousai_hokenritsu_kaitei.html: 令和8年度 unchanged). The payslip figure is the employer’s cost at the business type’s rate on the payslip’s wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額 and discards the yen fraction).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

rules.refusal: 労働者災害補償保険法 §3; 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(2): record the company’s workers_comp_business_type, the 労災保険率表 事業の種類の番号 of its labour-insurance relationship.

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（給与） (income tax withholding on wages)
authority: 所得税法 §183, §185, §190 and 別表第五 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 東日本大震災からの復興のための施策を実施するために必要な財源の確保に関する特別措置法 §28: the payer withholds 所得税 and 復興特別所得税 together on the pay due, by the 平成24年財務省告示第115号 tables that fold the 2.1% surtax in (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm; table selection https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm). The table read is the pay after the 社会保険料 deducted from it (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金, 子ども・子育て支援金, 雇用保険 employee shares of this payslip; 雇用保険 on a payslip that also pays a 賞与 is split pro rata to the wages, a recorded default). The pay-due date (the run’s pay date, else the period end) picks the year: 令和7年分 for pay due in 2025, 令和8年分 in 2026; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables (防衛特別所得税) are sealed. 月額表 甲欄 (§185(1)(i)) where the 扶養控除等申告書 is filed (withholding_column KOU) by the declared 扶養親族等の数, beyond seven the seven-dependant amount less JPY1,610 each; 乙欄 (OTSU) otherwise; 毎半月 pay reads the table on twice the pay and withholds half (§185(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ). 日額表 丙欄 (HEI, §185(1)(iii)) on each day’s pay: the period’s pay after insurance over its paid days (working days less unpaid days), equal daily pay being the recorded default. Weekly pay (日割額, §185(1)(i)ヘ) is refused until the 施行令 日割額 is configured. The entity fact gensen_electronic_calculation elects the 電算機計算の特例 (平成24年財務省告示第116号; 令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf, 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf) for monthly 甲欄 pay: salary deduction (rounded up to the yen), basic deduction and JPY31,667 per 扶養親族等 off the pay after insurance, the tax formula rounded to JPY10. Table amounts above the band table (JPY740,000 a month) add the stated percentage of the excess; the sub-yen fraction is dropped (recorded default). 非居住者 (§212, §213; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2884.htm): 20.42% of the taxable pay before insurance, sub-yen dropped. Taxable pay (所得税法 §9(1)(v), (vi); 所得税基本通達 36-38の2, 36-40–36-45): the 通勤手当 class COMMUTING above the monthly limit (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm) — transit terms fact commute_transit_fare plus the vehicle band for commute_vehicle_km one way (under 2 km nil; 2–10 km 4,200; 10–15 7,300; 15–25 13,500; 25–35 19,700; 35–45 25,900; 45–55 32,300; 55–65 38,700; from pay due 1 April 2026 65–75 45,700, 75–85 52,700, 85–95 59,600, 95+ 66,400, before then 38,700 from 55 km, and from then commute_parking_fee up to 5,000 where the vehicle distance is 2 km or more), at most JPY150,000; the in-kind meal class MEAL_IN_KIND (the month’s meal value before consumption tax) is untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge, fraction under JPY10 dropped, is at most JPY3,500 a month (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026; https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm), else the value less the charge is pay; employer housing (terms facts housing_provided and the 賃貸料相当額 inputs, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): 固定資産税課税標準額 of the building × 0.2% + JPY12 × floor area ÷ 3.3 m² + land × 0.22%, taxable less the worker’s rent unless the worker pays at least 50% of it, sub-yen dropped. 年末調整 (§190, the December last payment of a KOU resident whose year’s pay is at most JPY20m): the year’s regular and 賞与 pay (this employer’s slips plus the prior-employer 源泉徴収票 recorded as the scheme opening) gives the 給与所得控除後の給与等の金額 — 令和7年分 別表第五 (JPY651,000–1.9m less 650,000; name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（賞与） (income tax withholding on a bonus)
authority: 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 平成24年財務省告示第115号 別表第三 賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表 (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm): the 賞与 after its 社会保険料 (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金 and 子ども・子育て支援金 on the 標準賞与額, and the 雇用保険 share of the payslip pro rata to the bonus) × the rate read by the previous month’s ordinary pay after insurance and the 扶養親族等の数 (甲欄, seven and more in one column) or the 乙欄 (乙 and 丙), sub-yen dropped; where there was no ordinary pay in the previous month, or the bonus exceeds ten times it, §186(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ and §186(2): (the 月額表 amount on one sixth of the bonus plus that previous-month pay, less the amount on that pay) × 6. The previous month’s pay after insurance is the declared election prior_month_net_pay (0 for none): the scheme site cannot read an earlier payslip, so the payroll is refused without it. A bonus whose computation period exceeds six months (1/12, × 12) is not configured. 非居住者: 20.42%. The pay-due date picks the year as for INCOME_TAX; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables are sealed.

elections.label: 前月の社会保険料等控除後の給与等の金額
elections.description: 所得税法 §186(1)–(2): the ordinary pay due in the month before the bonus after its 社会保険料, 0 where none was due; a pay cycle of a whole number of months reads the monthly equivalent of the last ordinary pay. Record on the bonus month’s declaration.

rules.refusal: "所得税法 §2(1)(iii)–(v): record tax residency (RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT) on the employment terms before withholding: a resident is withheld by the 源泉徴収税額表, a non-resident at 20.42% (§212, §213); citizenship does not decide it."

"源泉徴収税額表: the pay due date falls outside the sealed 令和7年分・令和8年分 tables; pay due from 1 January 2027 needs the 令和9年分 tables (令和9年 防衛特別所得税, https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2027/01.htm), not yet sealed."

"所得税法 §186: the 賞与 rate is read on the previous month’s ordinary pay after 社会保険料. Record it as prior_month_net_pay on the INCOME_TAX_BONUS statutory fact for the bonus month (0 where no ordinary pay was due in the previous month) before withholding the bonus."

name: 個人住民税（特別徴収） (resident tax, special collection)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §321-3 (the municipality designates the salary payer as 特別徴収義務者), §321-4 (notice of the 特別徴収税額 by 31 May), §321-5(1) (one twelfth each month from June to the following May, withheld when pay is paid, remitted by the next month’s tenth; a notice received later is spread over the months from the month after it to May), §321-5(2) (a worker who stops receiving pay: no later installment is withheld, except that the remaining installments are withheld in one amount from the pay or retirement allowance paid by 31 May exceeding them — on the worker’s request for an event from 1 June to 31 December, always for an event from 1 January to 30 April), §20-4-2(6), (8) (the installment fractions under JPY100 fall to the first installment, so June differs); 森林環境税 is collected with it (森林環境税及び森林環境譲与税に関する法律 §7). The amounts are the municipality’s, never a national formula: the terms facts resident_tax_collection SPECIAL, resident_tax_fiscal_year, resident_tax_june_amount (the first installment), resident_tax_monthly_amount and resident_tax_first_month transcribe the 特別徴収税額の決定・変更通知書 (Shinjuku https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html). The pay date (else the period end) picks the installment month. Recorded defaults (owner rule 2026-09-28): one installment a month, on the month’s first payment; nothing withheld from a payslip that pays nothing; the exit collection is on the payslip of the pay period containing the last day, comparing its whole pay (wages, bonus and retirement allowance) with the remaining installments; unrecorded resident_tax_exit_collection is no request (June–December) and LUMP_SUM (January–April, as the statute requires); TRANSFER (the new employer continues the collection) and ORDINARY withhold the exit month’s installment only.
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

Record the municipality’s notice for the pay date’s 年度 on the employment terms (resident_tax_fiscal_year and its amounts), or ORDINARY where the notice leaves collection to the worker."

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（退職所得） (income tax withholding on a retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033) §30 (退職所得: the year’s 退職手当等 less the 退職所得控除額, halved; 短期退職手当等 — non-officer service of five years or less — halves only the first JPY3m of the excess and takes the rest whole, i.e. 1.5m + (payment − (3m + deduction)); 特定役員退職手当等 — 役員等 service of five years or less — is the whole excess; 退職所得控除額 JPY400,000 a year to 20 years, then 8m + 700,000 a year; less the §30(6)(i) amount for an earlier retirement allowance; at least 800,000; +1m for a retirement caused by disability), §89 (rates 5–45%), §201(1) (with the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書: tax on the 課税退職所得金額, its sub-JPY1,000 fraction dropped; an already-paid allowance of the same year and kind is combined and its tax deducted), §201(3) (without the declaration: 20% of the whole payment), §212–§213 (a non-resident: 20%). 施行令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096) §69 (service years: a part year counts as one), §70 (the overlap reduction: the deduction for the years a prior allowance covered — received within the previous four years, or from 2026 a DC lump sum within nine years and allowances then nine years back for one received from 2026 — fraction of a year dropped, §70(2) shortening them where the prior allowance fell short of its own deduction), §71 (disability). 復興特別所得税 2.1% (復興財源確保法 §28) so the tax is ×102.1%, 20.42% without a declaration; the sub-yen fraction dropped (NTA No.2732, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm, 令和8年4月1日現在). Inputs are exit facts: retirement_income_declaration, retirement_service_years (the §69 years; unrecorded is the stint through the last day, a part year one year), retirement_officer_service_years, retirement_disability, retirement_deduction_reduction_years (the §70 years the declaration shows), retirement_prior_same_year_amount/_income_tax/_kind. The class RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE is its only base. Mixed officer and employee service with a five-year part (施行令 §71-2) is refused.

rules.refusal: "所得税法 §2(1)(iii)–(v): record tax residency (RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT) on the employment terms before withholding on a retirement allowance: a resident’s is 退職所得 (§30, §201), a non-resident’s is withheld at 20.42% (§212, §213)."
"所得税法 §201; 復興財源確保法 §28: retirement withholding due from 1 January 2027 needs the 令和9年分 rates (令和9年 防衛特別所得税 alongside a reduced 復興特別所得税), not yet sealed."
"所得税法 §30(1): a 退職手当等 is paid by reason of retirement; record the employment’s last day (and its exit facts) before paying it."

name: 住民税 退職所得割（特別徴収） (resident tax on a retirement allowance)
authority: 地方税法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226) §50-2–§50-6 (道府県民税 4%) and §328–§328-6 (市町村民税 6%): the 退職所得割 on a 退職手当等 subject to 所得税法 §199 (a resident’s) is taxed apart from other income by the municipality and prefecture of the worker’s address on 1 January of the year it is payable, on the 退職所得の金額 computed as 所得税法 §30(2) (§328-2), special-collected by the payer at payment and remitted with a 納入申告書 by the next month’s tenth (§328-5); the declaration only adds an already-paid allowance of the year (§328-6(1)); without one the tax is the same computation on this payment (§328-6(2)). §20-4-2(1): the taxable amount drops its sub-JPY1,000 fraction; §20-4-2(3): each tax drops its sub-JPY100 fraction (municipal and prefectural computed apart). No 復興 surtax, no 森林環境税. Shinjuku retirement-tax procedure: https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_00005.html. Exit fact resident_tax_january_domicile false where the worker had no address in Japan on that 1 January; retirement_prior_same_year_resident_tax is the already-withheld amount.

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料 (health and care insurance)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §40 (50 grades of 標準報酬月額, JPY58,000–1,390,000), §156 (premium on the 標準報酬月額 for each month from acquisition to the month before loss), §160 (協会けんぽ branch rates), §161 (half each), §167(1) (the employer deducts only the previous month’s premium from pay; at loss the previous and the current month); 介護保険法 §9(2) (insured aged 40–64 pay the care rate with health). Rates: 協会けんぽ 保険料額表 — 令和8年度 rates for the collected month (care 1.62%), 令和8年度 for the current month (care 1.62%) (https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/about/business/insurance_rate/rate_prefectures/r08/; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx; https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r7ippan3.xlsx). The branch is the prefecture of the company (the 適用事業所), never the worker’s residence. Care applies from the month containing the day before the 40th birthday to the month before the one containing the day before the 65th; health ends on the 75th birthday (後期高齢者医療). Employee share rounding (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042; JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/nofu/20121026.html): deducted from pay, 50 sen and under is discarded and over 50 sen is one yen; the employer share is the month’s premium less that deduction. Maternity/childcare exemption (§159, §159-3): on the employer’s application no premium is collected for the exempt months (election premium_exemption).

elections.label: 標準報酬月額 (the grade of the month this payslip collects)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §40–43: the grade decided at acquisition (資格取得時決定), each September (定時決定, from April–June pay) and on a qualifying fixed-pay change (随時改定, from the fourth month). Payroll deducts the previous month’s premium (§167(1)), so date a revised grade from the first day of the month after the insurance month it takes effect (a September 定時決定 grade from 1 October); date the acquisition grade from the acquisition day. The pension grade is this grade bounded to the 厚生年金 table (厚生年金保険法 §20).

elections.label: 産前産後・育児休業等の保険料免除 (exempt collected month)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §159, §159-3; 厚生年金保険法 §81-2, §81-2-2: on the employer’s 申出, no health, care, pension or support premium is collected for the months from the month the leave starts to the month before the one containing the day after it ends (childcare leave inside one month: 14 days or more). Record MATERNITY or CHILDCARE for the exempt insurance months as the pension office accepted them, dated like the grade (from the month after the first exempt month to the month after the last). NONE is no exemption.

rules.refusal: 健康保険法 §35, §48: record the 健康保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since and the 標準報酬月額), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person outside compulsory cover.
健康保険法 §3, 介護保険法 §9(2), 厚生年金保険法 §9: care (40–64), pension (under 70) and health (under 75) cover turn on age. Record the date of birth before calculating payroll.
健康保険法 §156(3), 厚生年金保険法 §19(1): premiums run from the month of acquisition. Record the 資格取得日 as the registration since date.

Employee share rounded as HEALTH (50 sen down, over up; https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/nofu/20121026.html).

name: 健康保険料・介護保険料（賞与） (health and care insurance on a bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) §3(6) (a payment for labour made three or fewer times a year), §45(1) (標準賞与額: the bonus with sub-JPY1,000 discarded, at most JPY5,730,000 in the April–March year under one insurer), §156(1)(ii), §160, §161, §167(2) (deducted from the bonus); the bonus month’s own rates (令和8年度, care 1.62%, https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/assets/r8ippan3.xlsx); a bonus paid in the month of loss carries no premium but still counts toward the cap (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/hoshu/20141203.html). The cap is exact where the April–March total is recorded (standard_bonus_fiscal_year_prior); unrecorded, a bonus is priced only where this employer’s earlier standard bonuses since 1 January (and last year’s, for a January–March bonus) cannot reach the cap, and refused otherwise. Rounding as HEALTH.

elections.description: 健康保険法 §45(1): the 標準賞与額 already counted under this insurer since the last 1 April — this employer’s earlier bonuses, and a same-insurer earlier employer’s where the worker filed the 累計額 declaration. Recorded, the JPY5,730,000 cap is applied exactly.

elections.label: 賞与保険料免除 (maternity / childcare leave)
elections.description: 健康保険法 §159, §159-3; 厚生年金保険法 §81-2, §81-2-2: a bonus paid in an exempt month (childcare leave: leave of more than one month spanning the bonus month’s end) carries no health, care, pension or support premium on the employer’s 申出; the bonus still counts toward the cap. Date it over the bonus month.

name: 雇用保険料 (employment insurance)
authority: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) §4, §5 (every business employing a worker), §6 (not covered: under 20 contracted hours a week unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application; not expected to be employed 31 days or more; seasonal, students, certain crew and public servants), §37-5 (65-plus two-job special insured). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2) (賃金: every payment for labour, bonuses included), §2(4) (保険年度 1 April–31 March), §11 (premium = 賃金総額 × rate), §12(4) (雇用保険率), §31(1) (the insured worker bears 失業等給付・育児休業給付 at half the rate less the 二事業率), §32 (deducted from each wage payment). Rates per 1,000 (worker/employer): 令和7年度 general 5.5/9, agriculture-forestry-fisheries-sake 6.5/10, construction 6.5/11 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001401966.pdf); 令和8年度 (1 April 2026–31 March 2027) 5/8.5, 6/9.5, 6/10.5 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf). The rate is the fiscal year of the wage closing date (賃金締切日): a March close paid in April stays at the 令和7年度 rate — the run’s settings version is the one covering the salary window’s end. Worker share rounding when deducted from wages (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/www2/topics/seido/daijin/hoken/980916_3.htm): 50銭以下切り捨て、50銭を超える場合は切り上げ. Enrolment guidance: https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/0000147331.html. The employer share on a payslip is its rate on the same wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

elections.label: 被保険者の種類 (insured category)
elections.description: 雇用保険法 §6(i), §37-5: GENERAL for an ordinary insured worker (20 contracted hours a week or more, 31 days expected); MULTI_JOB_65 for a 65-plus worker insured on application through two employments (each 5 to under 20 hours, 20 combined), who pays on this employer’s own wages.

rules.refusal: 雇用保険法 §4–§7: record the 雇用保険 資格取得 (REGISTERED, with the acquisition date as since), or NOT_REGISTERED for a person §6 excludes (under 20 contracted hours a week, not expected to be employed 31 days, a student, seasonal work).
労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4): the employment-insurance rate turns on the business class. Record the company’s employment_insurance_class (GENERAL, AGRICULTURE_SAKE or CONSTRUCTION).

雇用保険法 §6(i): a worker contracted for under 20 hours a week is not an insured person unless a §37-5 高年齢被保険者 on application. Record the registration NOT_REGISTERED, the insured_category MULTI_JOB_65, or correct the contracted week.

name: 労災保険料 (workers’ compensation insurance, employer only)
authority: 労働者災害補償保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000050) §3 (every business employing a worker). 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084) §2(2), §11 (賃金総額 × rate), §12(2) (労災保険率 by business type), §12(3) (メリット制), §31 (the worker bears none: employer only). Rate table: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行; https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/roudoukijun/rousai/rousaihoken06/rousai_hokenritsu_kaitei.html: 令和8年度 unchanged). The payslip figure is the employer’s cost at the business type’s rate on the payslip’s wage, the sub-yen fraction dropped (recorded default: the annual 年度更新 settles on the fiscal-year 賃金総額 and discards the yen fraction).
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + DAY_PAY + NIGHT_PREMIUM + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

rules.refusal: 労働者災害補償保険法 §3; 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(2): record the company’s workers_comp_business_type, the 労災保険率表 事業の種類の番号 of its labour-insurance relationship.

name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（給与） (income tax withholding on wages)
authority: 所得税法 §183, §185, §190 and 別表第五 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 東日本大震災からの復興のための施策を実施するために必要な財源の確保に関する特別措置法 §28: the payer withholds 所得税 and 復興特別所得税 together on the pay due, by the 平成24年財務省告示第115号 tables that fold the 2.1% surtax in (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm; table selection https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm). The table read is the pay after the 社会保険料 deducted from it (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金, 子ども・子育て支援金, 雇用保険 employee shares of this payslip; 雇用保険 on a payslip that also pays a 賞与 is split pro rata to the wages, a recorded default). The pay-due date (the run’s pay date, else the period end) picks the year: 令和7年分 for pay due in 2025, 令和8年分 in 2026; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables (防衛特別所得税) are sealed. 月額表 甲欄 (§185(1)(i)) where the 扶養控除等申告書 is filed (withholding_column KOU) by the declared 扶養親族等の数, beyond seven the seven-dependant amount less JPY1,610 each; 乙欄 (OTSU) otherwise; 毎半月 pay reads the table on twice the pay and withholds half (§185(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ). 日額表 丙欄 (HEI, §185(1)(iii)) on each day’s pay: the period’s pay after insurance over its paid days (working days less unpaid days), equal daily pay being the recorded default. Weekly pay (日割額, §185(1)(i)ヘ) is refused until the 施行令 日割額 is configured. The entity fact gensen_electronic_calculation elects the 電算機計算の特例 (平成24年財務省告示第116号; 令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf, 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf) for monthly 甲欄 pay: salary deduction (rounded up to the yen), basic deduction and JPY31,667 per 扶養親族等 off the pay after insurance, the tax formula rounded to JPY10. Table amounts above the band table (JPY740,000 a month) add the stated percentage of the excess; the sub-yen fraction is dropped (recorded default). 非居住者 (§212, §213; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2884.htm): 20.42% of the taxable pay before insurance, sub-yen dropped. Taxable pay (所得税法 §9(1)(v), (vi); 所得税基本通達 36-38の2, 36-40–36-45): the 通勤手当 class COMMUTING above the monthly limit (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm) — transit terms fact commute_transit_fare plus the vehicle band for commute_vehicle_km one way (under 2 km nil; 2–10 km 4,200; 10–15 7,300; 15–25 13,500; 25–35 19,700; 35–45 25,900; 45–55 32,300; 55–65 38,700; from pay due 1 April 2026 65–75 45,700, 75–85 52,700, 85–95 59,600, 95+ 66,400, before then 38,700 from 55 km, and from then commute_parking_fee up to 5,000 where the vehicle distance is 2 km or more), at most JPY150,000; the in-kind meal class MEAL_IN_KIND (the month’s meal value before consumption tax) is untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge, fraction under JPY10 dropped, is at most JPY3,500 a month (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026; https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm), else the value less the charge is pay; employer housing (terms facts housing_provided and the 賃貸料相当額 inputs, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): 固定資産税課税標準額 of the building × 0.2% + JPY12 × floor area ÷ 3.3 m² + land × 0.22%, taxable less the worker’s rent unless the worker pays at least 50% of it, sub-yen dropped. 年末調整 (§190, the December last payment of a KOU resident whose year’s pay is at most JPY20m): the year’s regular and 賞与 pay (this employer’s slips plus the prior-employer 源泉徴収票 recorded as the scheme opening) gives the 給与所得控除後の給与等の金額 — 令和7年分 別表第五 (JPY651,000–1.9m less 650,000; JPY1.9m–6.6m on the pay floored to JPY4,000: 70% less 80,000 to 3.6m, 80% less 440,000 above; e-Gov text as of 1 December 2025, every row checked) and 令和8年分 租税特別措置法 §29の4 with 別表第五 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1410.htm: under JPY741,000 nil, to 2.191m less 740,000, 1,451,000 / 1,453,000 / 1,456,000 to 2.2m, then 別表第五), 90% less 1.1m from 6.6m, less 1.95m from 8.5m — less 所得金額調整控除 (yearend_income_adjustment, https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1411.htm); name: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税（賞与） (income tax withholding on a bonus)
authority: 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 平成24年財務省告示第115号 別表第三 賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表 (令和8年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/01.htm; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/02.htm): the 賞与 after its 社会保険料 (健康保険・介護保険, 厚生年金 and 子ども・子育て支援金 on the 標準賞与額, and the 雇用保険 share of the payslip pro rata to the bonus) × the rate read by the previous month’s ordinary pay after insurance and the 扶養親族等の数 (甲欄, seven and more in one column) or the 乙欄 (乙 and 丙), sub-yen dropped; where there was no ordinary pay in the previous month, or the bonus exceeds ten times it, §186(1)(i)ロ, (ii)ロ and §186(2): (the 月額表 amount on one sixth of the bonus plus that previous-month pay, less the amount on that pay) × 6. The previous month’s pay after insurance is the declared election prior_month_net_pay (0 for none): the scheme site cannot read an earlier payslip, so the payroll is refused without it. A bonus whose computation period exceeds six months (1/12, × 12) is not configured. 非居住者: 20.42%. The pay-due date picks the year as for INCOME_TAX; pay due from 1 January 2027 is refused until the 令和9年分 tables are sealed.

elections.label: 前月の社会保険料等控除後の給与等の金額
elections.description: 所得税法 §186(1)–(2): the ordinary pay due in the month before the bonus after its 社会保険料, 0 where none was due; a pay cycle of a whole number of months reads the monthly equivalent of the last ordinary pay. Record on the bonus month’s declaration.

rules.refusal: "所得税法 §2(1)(iii)–(v): record tax residency (RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT) on the employment terms before withholding: a resident is withheld by the 源泉徴収税額表, a non-resident at 20.42% (§212, §213); citizenship does not decide it."

"源泉徴収税額表: the pay due date falls outside the sealed 令和7年分・令和8年分 tables; pay due from 1 January 2027 needs the 令和9年分 tables (令和9年 防衛特別所得税, https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2027/01.htm), not yet sealed."

"所得税法 §186: the 賞与 rate is read on the previous month’s ordinary pay after 社会保険料. Record it as prior_month_net_pay on the INCOME_TAX_BONUS statutory fact for the bonus month (0 where no ordinary pay was due in the previous month) before withholding the bonus."
